    • initialize

      public boolean initialize(String timestampFormat, boolean consoleOutputEnabled, boolean outputFileEnabled, String outputFilePath)
      Initialize the MarasmiumKit application framework's logging system
      Parameters:
      timestampFormat - The initial format to apply to timestamps generated by the logging system
      consoleOutputEnabled - Whether the logging system will initially write messages to the console
      outputFileEnabled - Whether the logging system will initially write messages to a file
      outputFilePath - The initial file path for the logging system to write messages to
      Returns:
      Whether the parameters were valid and the logging system was initialized successfully
